name: shifting-mirage-stealth-when-opponent-cannot-pay
notes: Shifting Mirage (hmjr33ijq6): when the opponent holds fewer than 2 cards ShiftingMirageResolve() skips the YES/NO and applies the stealth turn effect directly while still under player 1's own perspective, so the CASTER's champion gains STEALTH (the declined-payment path, which resolves it inside the opponent's action, is covered by shifting-mirage-tristan-bonus-shadow-stealth-opponent-declines). The opponent's hand is emptied through the generator's emptyZone setup step. The Tristan Bonus Ominous Shadow is summoned as well. The single reserve payment is the double-Class-Bonus-discount engine bug (printed 3 -> 1 instead of 2), pinned with a REGRESSION GUARD.

rulesClauses: Your champion gains stealth until end of turn unless an opponent pays (2) (opponent cannot pay).
[Tristan Bonus] Summon an Ominous Shadow token.

engineBug.summary: Shifting Mirage's printed '[Class Bonus] This card costs 1 less to activate' is applied TWICE: once by the generated activationCostModifierAbilities['hmjr33ijq6:0'] (via ApplyGeneratedReserveLikeCostModifiers) and once more by the hand-maintained ClassBonusActivateCostReduction() table (which still lists hmjr33ijq6). With the Class Bonus active, printed reserve 3 becomes 1 instead of 2. Confirmed live by calling the engine's own cost functions on the fixture's initial state: ApplyGeneratedReserveLikeCostModifiers(...,3,'activate') = 2, ClassBonusActivateCostReduction('hmjr33ijq6') = 1, CalculateActivationReserveCost() = 1.
engineBug.affectedFunction: Custom/GameLogic.php CalculateActivationReserveCost() (~line 26207) applying ClassBonusActivateCostReduction() on top of the generated activationCostModifierAbilities['hmjr33ijq6:0'] discount.
